title: Anthropic courses (Anthropic Academy)
summary: Anthropic's public course catalog listing 23 courses/paths, from Claude 101 and AI Fluency to Claude Code, agent skills, subagents, MCP and the Claude API. Catalog cards show only titles and one-line descriptions.
practicalCost: Courses are marked 'Register | FREE'. Hands-on parts vary: Claude Code 101 needs a Claude Pro/Max/Enterprise account or API key; Claude Platform 101 needs an Anthropic Console API key 'plus a small amount of prepaid credit'.
prerequisites: Varies by course; AI Fluency and Claude 101 have none stated; API/MCP courses require Python proficiency.

title: OpenAI Academy Courses
summary: OpenAI's course hub, grouped into Apply AI at Work, Learn the Latest, Build with AI (OpenAI API and Codex), Lead AI Adoption, and Teach and Learn with AI. Courses are self-paced, and each course in the core series ends with an assessment leading to an Accredible badge.
practicalCost: Course pages list 'A ChatGPT account' under 'What you'll need'. Agents and Workflows also needs 'Access to agent capabilities'. Astra at Work says ChatGPT Work is available 'on supported plans'. Builder courses need dev/API experience; the course pages don't say whether API credits are needed.
prerequisites: AI Foundations: none ('No technical background is required'). Builder courses: hands-on software development and API experience.

subItems.title: AI Foundations
subItems.note: Duration: ~70 minutes; Level: Introduction; needs ChatGPT account + real work task. Assessment (80% pass) for badge.

subItems.title: Applied AI Foundations
subItems.note: Duration: ~80 minutes; Level: Intermediate; turn a recurring task into a workflow; recommends AI Foundations first.

subItems.title: Agents and Workflows
subItems.note: Duration: ~90 minutes; Level: Intermediate; directing agents; needs 'Access to agent capabilities'.

subItems.title: Astra at Work (Enterprise Release Activation: October 2026)

subItems.title: Build with Retrieval-Augmented Generation

subItems.title: Optimize AI Application Performance

subItems.title: Get Started with Codex

subItems.title: Extend Codex Workflows
